{{recipesummary|category=Recipes for pastries|servings=4|time=1 hour|difficulty=3
}}{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of the United Kingdom|Cuisine of the UK]]

Just like what Rick Steves ate on his 'Travels in Europe' show, when he visited Cornwall.

==Ingredients==
* 2 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] (400 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) [[Cookbook:Cube|cubed]] cooking roast [[Cookbook:Beef|beef]], in ¼-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] (65 [[Cookbook:Mm|mm]])  pieces
* 1½ cup (350 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|mL]]) cubed cooked [[Cookbook:Potato|potatoes]]
* 1 cup (240 mL) beef [[Cookbook:Broth|broth]]
* ½ cup (120 mL) diced cooked [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoon]] (15 mL) [[Cookbook:Parsley|parsley]]
* ¼ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] (1 mL) [[Cookbook:Thyme|thyme]]
* ½ teaspoon (3 mL) [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* ⅛–¼ teaspoon (1–3 mL) [[Cookbook:Pepper|pepper]]
* [[Cookbook:Pastry Dough|Pastry]] for double crust [[Cookbook:Pie|pie]] (9-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] or 22 [[Cookbook:Centimetre (cm)|cm]])
* [[Cookbook:Cream|Half and half cream]]

==Procedure==
# Preheat [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to [[Cookbook:Oven_temperatures|450°F]] (230°C).
# Combine beef, potatoes, broth, onion, parsley, thyme, salt, and pepper. Set aside.
# On a lightly [[Cookbook:Flour|floured]] surface, roll out ¼ of the pastry into an 8-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] (20 [[Cookbook:Centimetre (cm)|cm]]) circle.
# Mound 1 cup (240 mL) of filling on half of circle.
# Moisten edge of pastry with [[Cookbook:Water|water]].
# Fold dough over filling. Crimp edges with fork to seal.
# Place on ungreased [[Cookbook:Cookie Sheet|baking sheet]].
# Repeat with remaining pastry and filling.
# Cut slits in top of each completed pastry.
# [[Cookbook:Brush|Brush]] tops with cream.
# [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown.
